text:
maria: Quick preflight — EU quiet window starts in 40min. Need final pin decisions, smoke checklist, and rollback owners.

devon: I propose we pin v3.4.2 to canary only, leave stable at v3.4.1. Less blast radius.

raj: Agree with canary pin. If canary error rate > 0.5% over 5min we'll rollback to v3.4.1. Who's owning rollback?

ellen: I'll own rollback and postmortem if needed. Oncall will coordinate traffic cut.

maria: Ellen you're official rollback owner. @sre-oncall will do traffic adjustments and monitor global tail latency.

sre-oncall: I'll be watching P95/P99 and the deploy-latency graph. Set alerts: p99 > 600ms or error rate spike > 0.5%.

devon: Smoke checklist in case helpful:
```
- run smoke on staging: ./scripts/smoke.sh --suite quick
- sanity prompts: "echo 'hello' | /api/v1/generate"
- embeddings sample: curl -X POST /embeddings -d '{"text":"sample"}'
- end-to-end latency test (50 reqs)
```

maria: Good. We'll run smoke 20m before quiet window. deploy-bot, can you pin canary?

deploy-bot: @maria acknowledged. Running pin workflow. Command run:
```
/deploy pin --env=canary --version=v3.4.2 --reason="quiet-window canary pin"
```
Action queued, ETA ~20s. :gear:

deploy-bot: Pin complete. Canary now at v3.4.2. Audit: deploy-bot@ops at 1733337025.

devon: Running quick smoke now. Posting failures if any.

devon: Smoke results: 50/50 success, median latency 120ms, p95 220ms. No obvious regressions.

raj: I'll enable gradual traffic shift to canary (10% -> 50% over 15m) if no errors.

maria: Hold on traffic shift until the 10m mark post-smoke. We want stable baseline.

ellen: If error rate crosses threshold, I'll trigger rollback with this command:
```
/deploy rollback --to-version=v3.4.1 --reason="canary regression"
```
I'll also notify #incidents and open a Sev2 if user impact > 1%.

sre-oncall: Noted. My playbook step 1: pause traffic shift, step 2: pin-unwind if rollback required, step 3: run cache invalidation if needed.

maria: One more operational tradeoff: we can avoid full rollback by applying a config toggle for the feature flag (FFFAST). If devon confirms quick toggle is safe, we can opt for that first.

devon: Config toggle is safe for short-term. I'll prepare the toggle command and have it ready: `ffctl set FFFAST off --env=canary`.

maria: Sweet. Final checklist before quiet window:
- pin applied ✅
- smoke passed ✅
- rollback owner assigned ✅
- monitoring alerts set ✅
- FF toggle ready ✅

ellen: I'll be in the channel during the window. Pager duty contact: @sre-oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic holdpoint created at 1733337080. Use `/deploy shift --to=canary --pct=10` when ready.

maria: Thanks team. If anything, call me directly. :phone: 10min until quiet window start.

devon: :thumbsup: running final quick check now.

raj: Ready on my side for traffic ops.

ellen: Standing by for rollback or FF toggle.

sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards up. Will post baseline numbers at +5m and +15m.

maria: Copy. Locking channel for updates only during the quiet period. Keep messages short and prefix with status tags (e.g., [ALERT], [INFO], [ROLLBACK]).
